subject: demo-agent-wallet
note: Hacksgiving demo mandate: Thanksgiving dinner essentials, budget $100 per rolling 24h (window, not calendar day — arc R1 M8). subject is an opaque demo ledger key, not a real hex address. Only dailyUsd+velocity are set: any perTx < cart would deny as PER_TX instead of the documented DAILY_CAP_EXCEEDED (caps must be monotonic perTx <= daily). Prices are computed server-side from the trusted catalog; client-declared amounts are ignored (arc R1 C2).
